name: script_and_hand
description: Whether each page is printed in roman, italic or blackletter type, written by hand, a mixture, or without text.

questions.name: script
questions.instructions: Which script or hand does most of the text on the page use?

choices.blackletter: Printed in blackletter type, such as Fraktur, textura or schwabacher.
choices.mixed: Two or more of these, each in a substantial part of the page.
